title: WorkItem
description: Single source of truth for ERP automation work item types. Generated into TS and Python via `make generate-types`.

case_id.description: Canonical case identity and the table's sole partition key: {document_number}-{item_id}. Also the form used off-table — SQS bodies and MessageGroupId, ticket correlation, prompts, URLs, session ids. Built and parsed only via the case_key codec (lambdas/layers/shared_types/case_key.py, frontend/src/lib/caseKey.ts).

document_number.description: SAP document number (e.g. supplier invoice). An attribute, not identity — SAP calls and display need it.

item_id.description: Item identifier within the document. An attribute, not identity.

domain.description: Skill domain this item belongs to.

process_type.description: Specific process type for skill routing, e.g. invoice_matching, price_variance.

purchase_order.description: AP: PO number referenced on the invoice line item.

invoice_quantity.description: AP: Invoiced quantity in PO unit.

ticket_id.description: Related demo ticket ID while the case awaits a supervised response.

inquiry_sent_at.description: ISO timestamp of the outbound inquiry that put the case into awaiting_human_input. Server-owned: stamped by case_management_lambda on entry to that status and cleared on leaving it, never taken from model-authored updates — it is what lets the handover claim 'waiting 6d' rather than 'last activity 6d'.

action_log.description: Append-only audit trail, one entry per update_case_state call. Written by case_management_lambda on every update.

ttl.description: DynamoDB TTL (epoch seconds). Only set by the eval regression harness on seeded synthetic cases (7-day expiry) so they self-clean; real cases never carry this.

user_rating.description: Case-level resolution quality rating from a human reviewer.

user_rating_at.description: ISO timestamp of when the rating was submitted.

agent_traces.description: Historical agent thought-process traces, one per invocation.

cost_summary.description: Per-case accumulated agent cost. Written by basic_agent._save_trace_to_ddb.

traces_dropped.description: Count of oldest traces evicted by the per-case trace cap, so the UI can state that history was thinned rather than thinning it silently.

Domain.description: Skill domain — aligns with skills/ folder names.

CaseStatus.description: `error` is terminal-until-retried: the SOPs and skill prompts instruct the agent to write it when a tool call fails irrecoverably, so it must be a first-class state rather than a value the UI silently renders as 'Detected'.

action.description: Action name the caller supplied, e.g. sap_updated, invoice_released.

outcome.description: Invocation result: complete, stopped, cancelled, error, disconnected.

sop_version.description: Version the injected SOP declared in its own header, read at resolve_skill time. Names the authority this run actually followed, which a precedent row citing the case must reproduce even after the SOP is revised.

clauses_available.description: DEPRECATED — no longer produced. Was the clause-number baseline a `per §N.N` citation was graded against, which passed a fabricated rule wearing a real number; `Evidence.citation` grades the quoted span instead. The key stays declared because AgentTrace forbids extra keys, so removing it would make every already-persisted trace fail validation.

tool_call_id.description: SDK toolUseId. Joins a stream-folded segment to the evidence the AfterToolCallEvent hook extracted.

status.description: ToolResult.status as reported by the SDK. On the segment rather than inside evidence because it is SDK-native, not derived.

evidence.description: Structured provenance for this tool step. Absent on any trace stored before the T.1 migration.

Evidence.description: Deterministic provenance for one tool call. Only `kind` is required — an unknown tool falls through to `computation` with no source rather than failing.

at.description: ISO timestamp of the tool call.

op.description: sap_write only — the three write shapes do not render as the same kind of diff.

fields.description: Field values read or written. The timeline renders these, never model prose.

clauses_retrieved.description: sop_lookup only — numbered clauses found in the retrieved SOP text. A human locator, not a verification key: most SOPs carry no numbers, so `citation` is what grades.

citation.description: notification and case_update only — the SOP sentence the agent quoted, checked against the text this run was given.

truncated.description: True when the tool_input or tool_result preview hit its size budget.

proposed_write.description: notification only — the write the agent is asking permission to make. The one model-supplied key in an otherwise deterministic model, so its `current` values are verified client-side against the run's reads rather than trusted.

Citation.description: A quoted SOP sentence and whether it is present in the text the run was given. Absent when the agent quoted nothing gradeable — which is a different state from quoting something absent.

quote.description: The span as the agent wrote it, before normalization.

verified.description: False means the span is not in what the agent was shown. It is NOT on its own proof the SOP was violated — a compliant agent that paraphrases lands here too, so the render must never present it as one.

ProposedWrite.description: A write declared as structured intent at escalation time, so an approval can render as a diff instead of prose.

op.description: Shares the record half's discriminator — a proposal and a record describe the same three write shapes.

current.description: Absent on a create, and absent whenever the agent did not read the value in this run.

EvidenceKind.description: Drives the timeline's row rendering, so the UI never pattern-matches tool names.

EvidenceSource.description: Where a value came from in SAP.

EvidenceAuthz.description: The three authorization facts that are actually available. The matched Cedar policy id is not obtainable from the Gateway.

mode.description: Whether a denial would have blocked.

outcome.description: Absent when a call failed for a non-authorization reason.

CostSummary.description: Per-case accumulated agent cost and token counts, summed across every invocation.
